error: identity_unavailable: The daemon cannot tell who the caller is right now.
fix: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command later with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
side effects: none (the command was not applied)
recovery: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
retry: 3 maximum; After caller identity is available; wait briefly between retries.
docs: docs/errors.md#identity_unavailable
context: environmentVariable=SPUR_SESSION
requestId: req-example-123
